title: Packet body
description: The signed part of every packet. Alerts, jobs and revocations carry a readable 'public' payload signed by the command post. Everything else carries a 'sealed' payload that only the command post can open. Payload shapes are in payloads/<kind>.schema.json.

id.description: UUID v4 made by the sender. The server drops repeats by this ID.

from_device.description: Short device ID, or 'command_post' for packets made by the server.

pubkey.description: Base64 Ed25519 public key of the sender (32 bytes). May be empty only while signatures are switched off.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, phone time corrected by the offset from the setup QR.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Phones drop the packet after this; default created_at + 24 h.

area.description: Geohash, normally 5 characters (about a 5 km box). The only location outside the seal.

replace_key.description: Optional. Phones keep only the newest packet with the same key, e.g. 'ping:boat_2'.

to_device.description: Optional. For jobs: the only device that shows it.

sealed.description: Base64 libsodium sealed box of the payload JSON, sealed to the command post box key. While sealing is off in development: base64 of the plain payload JSON.

public.description: Readable payload, only for alert, job and revoke.
